result.topic_en: Sketches of curves and regions in a plane with marked points ±1, ±∞ (cases x > α and x < α), together with calculations involving a first-order differential relation between x and s containing log((1+s)/(1-s)), the substitution t = (1+s)/(1-s), and a second-order differential equation in u with a parameter λ.

Möbius substitution t = (1+s)/(1-s) and its inverse
